share_configs.guide.trigger: View the WeChat Open Platform application guide
share_configs.guide.title: How do I obtain a WeChat sharing AppID?
share_configs.guide.welcome: New to this? You are in the right place
share_configs.guide.intro: Follow these five steps to prepare and apply. Confirm the native identifiers of the production build before entering them in WeChat Open Platform so an approved application can launch WeChat successfully.
share_configs.guide.steps.account.title: 1. Register a WeChat Open Platform account
share_configs.guide.steps.account.descri: Sign in with your organization's account and complete developer qualification as requested. Platform requirements can change, so use the latest instructions shown during application.
share_configs.guide.steps.account.requir: Prepare the company or organization documents and the administrator's identity and contact details.
Prepare the App name, icon, introduction, official website, and privacy policy.
share_configs.guide.steps.application.de: Go to Management Center → Mobile Applications → Create Mobile Application and register the platforms you will actually release.
share_configs.guide.steps.application.re: Keep the App name, icon, and functional description consistent with the App you plan to publish.
Do not use a temporary package or test Bundle ID; WeChat validates the native identity of the installed build.
share_configs.guide.steps.identity.title: 3. Enter native identities for each platform
share_configs.guide.steps.identity.descr: Enable only the platforms you use, and copy identifiers from the production project or signed artifact.
share_configs.guide.steps.identity.requi: Android: enter the production package name and the application signature for the release certificate.
iOS: enter the Bundle ID and an HTTPS Universal Link, and configure Associated Domains correctly.
HarmonyOS: enter the production Bundle Name and prepare the signing identity described by the official WeChat guide.
share_configs.guide.steps.review.title: 4. Submit for review and record the AppID
share_configs.guide.steps.review.descrip: Submit after checking the materials and native identities. Once approved, copy the AppID beginning with wx from the mobile application details.
share_configs.guide.steps.review.require: Use the review status, requested materials, and timeline currently shown by WeChat Open Platform.
Keep the AppID. Sharing does not require AppSecret, and AppSecret must never be embedded in a client.
share_configs.guide.steps.appkernia.titl: 5. Finish configuration and rebuild in AppKernia
share_configs.guide.steps.appkernia.desc: After receiving the AppID, complete this configuration and bind it to the target App.
share_configs.guide.steps.appkernia.requ: Enter the AppID, enable the required platforms, save the draft, and activate it after review.
Open App Management → Actions → Share configuration, bind and run preflight, then export and rebuild the App.
Verify contacts, Moments, and Favorites on a physical device with WeChat installed; a successful build is not physical-device acceptance.
share_configs.guide.links.createApplicat: Read the mobile application creation guide
share_configs.guide.checklist.title: Quick pre-submission checklist
share_configs.guide.checklist.approved: The WeChat mobile application is approved and the correct AppID is available.
share_configs.guide.checklist.identity: Package name, application signature, Bundle ID, and Bundle Name exactly match the production build.
share_configs.guide.checklist.universal_: The iOS Universal Link uses HTTPS and its domain and Associated Domains are configured correctly.
share_configs.guide.checklist.device: The App has been rebuilt after binding, and a physical device with WeChat is ready for acceptance.
share_configs.guide.secret.title: Do not enter AppSecret here
share_configs.guide.secret.description: WeChat content sharing requires only AppID and native platform identities. AppSecret is a sensitive server credential; this share configuration never collects, stores, or distributes it.
